exact_consequences: On fixed finite hidden support with positive base masses, common scaling converges to the target mass among global maximizers; it converges to one exactly when every global maximizer is in the target overt fibre.
A symmetric four-parse configuration remains at target probability 1/2 for every scale.
A three-target-versus-one-better-wrong configuration has probability 3/(3+exp(t)): it equals 3/5 at log(2), equals 1/2 at log(3), and tends to zero.
The finite wrong-to-target probability obeys the stated exponential error envelope.
no_conclusion_if: candidate support is infinite without an attained maximum
base masses, support, scaling direction, or the hidden-to-overt map change under scaling
the displayed rounded table is treated as a complete exact score ledger
a learning-algorithm convergence claim is requested
source_correspondence_boundary: The source supplies the hidden-candidate MaxEnt aggregation, overt-fibre success criterion, and common-scaling statement. The complete fixed-support limit theorem, symmetric case, multiplicity reversal, and error envelope are project derivations; the incomplete rounded source table is not reclassified.
verification_boundary: Lean proves the finite-support asymptotics and exact counterexamples under the encoded hypotheses. It does not prove the source transcription, hidden representation, learner convergence, empirical adequacy, or literature priority.
withdrawal_condition: Withdraw the source-level instantiation if the authoritative model scales support, base masses, or the hidden-to-overt consequence map together with weights; the abstract fixed-support results remain valid.
